variants.rectus_femoris: A third (tendinous) head to the iliofemoral ligament / greater trochanter was found on 83 % of 96 sides by Tubbs 2006 (Folia Morphol 65:377-80, PMID 17171618); a variant, not modelled.
variants.flexor_pollicis_longus: An accessory head from the medial epicondyle / coronoid (Gantzer's muscle) is a common variant; not modelled.
variants.biceps_brachii: A third (humeral) head is a recognised variant; not modelled.
